messages:
Maya R: Heads up — Acme asked us to bring up Orchid-18B for Dedicated. They want an int8 quant option and a quick sanity report: latency (p50/p95), token cost delta, and a small hallucination/regression check on their support transcripts. Can we triage?

Leo H: I can pick up quant baseline. Do we have a reference FP16 run for Orchid from model-catalog? If not, need a smoke perf run first. @Sanjay P any exported ckpt artifacts already validated?

Sanjay P: We have a huggingface release bundle (orchid-18b-v1) in /mnt/models/exports/orchid/18b/v1. Ran a tiny fp16 sanity earlier — no shape mismatches. Didn’t run full perf.

Maya R: Cool. Priority is: 1) perf baseline FP16, 2) quantize int8 w/ per-channel, 3) quick quality eval (50 support threads + targeted prompts), 4) produce a one-page ops checklist for Dedicated. ETA from quant side? :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Leo H: I'll queue a perf run on a single A100-80G node tonight. Plan: run 64-token generation at batch sizes [1,4,8], measure p50/p95 and token/s. Then run int8 quant using our new calibrator with 1k calibration steps.

Eva L: For quality, I'll re-use the Acme-support prompt set they sent (sample_50.json). Quick eval plan: 1) NLL/perp delta on heldout, 2) hallucination heuristic (entity halluc score), 3) a small red-team prompt set for system instructions. Will run both fp16 and int8.

Sanjay P: FYI int8 path will use GPTQ-ish pipeline + kernel selection flags. Need to test KV cache integrity for long context (4k) — some models had off-by-one cache reorder bugs when quantized.

Leo H: Noted. Will include a 4k KV smoke test. Also will capture per-layer activation histograms to sanity-check quant scales.

ops-bot: Deploy job queued: job_id=dj-8812, node_group=dedicated-staging-a, image=redwood/infer:canary. Expected start ~2026-03-20T02:15Z

Maya R: Risk checklist for PM/CS: data residency for Acme (they asked for VPC), fallback model if int8 shows >2% quality delta, and SLO targets to propose. Can someone draft the one-pager?

Eva L: I can draft the ops one-pager after runs. Will include: run matrix, perf numbers, delta table (cost vs latency), suggested rollout (canary 5% -> 25% -> 100%), and rollback criteria.

Leo H: Quick commands I'm running (copying here):
```bash
# perf baseline fp16
python run_infer.py --model /mnt/models/exports/orchid/18b/v1 --dtype fp16 --batch-sizes 1,4,8 --max-tokens 64 --out perf_fp16.json

# quantize (per-channel, 8-bit)
python quantize.py --model /mnt/models/exports/orchid/18b/v1 --method perchannel-gptq --calib-file calib_1k.json --out orchard_18b_int8.bin
```

Sanjay P: Add this to the checklist: verify logits parity for first 5 tokens between fp16 and int8 within tolerance (abs diff < 1e-2 after scale). Also validate tokenizer byte-pair mapping — Orchard tokenization had a subtle split change in earlier releases.

Maya R: Good catch. @Leo can you include tokenizer diff check as part of the smoke tests?

Leo H: Yep. Will diff token ids for 100 seed prompts and log mismatches.

Eva L: For hallucination heuristic: I'll flag any produced entity that doesn't match the ground-truth spans in Acme transcripts. Quick metric: halluc_rate = flagged_entities / total_entities. If int8 increases halluc_rate by > 1.5x, mark as regression.

Maya R: Nice metric. Also capture generation temperature/beam parity. The customer sometimes runs T=0.2 so include that.

ops-bot: job dj-8812 started on node gpu-7a at 2026-03-20T02:16:12Z

Leo H: Perf run done (quick summary): p50=95ms @batch1, p95=180ms @batch1, tokens/s ~540. Will upload perf_fp16.json to /tmp/orchid/perf_fp16.json. Starting quant pipeline now.

Sanjay P: If quant fails with nan activations, try per-channel+act-order fallback (two-blocks) and re-check. I've seen layernorm scale issues cause nans.

Leo H: Quant completed. Initial int8 perf: p50=70ms, p95=150ms, tokens/s ~740. Cost delta ~ -32% (est). However, first-token logits diff exceeded tolerance on 2/100 seed prompts. Investigating.

Eva L: Quality quick-pass: fp16 halluc_rate=0.04, int8 halluc_rate=0.055 on the 50-sample set. That's ~1.37x increase — below the 1.5x practical threshold but worth surfacing. Will run extended 500-sample run tomorrow.

Maya R: Good. Can we produce a short recommendation: allow int8 behind a canary with 10% traffic and automated monitoring on halluc_rate and latency? Also propose auto-fallback to fp16 if halluc_rate delta > 0.02 absolute or latency SLO breach.

Leo H: Draft recommendation: enable int8 for workloads that are latency-sensitive with canary 10% -> 50% -> 100%, monitor: p95 latency, halluc_rate, top-1 logits parity. Automatic fallback policy: if halluc_rate_int8 - halluc_rate_fp16 > 0.02 OR p95_int8 > p95_fp16 * 1.2 then rollback.

Sanjay P: I'll prepare a small validation script to run in the Dedicated control plane post-deploy that verifies kv-cache fidelity and token-delta on warmed sessions.

Eva L: One-pager draft (high level): 1) Baseline fp16 perf numbers (attached path), 2) int8 perf + cost delta, 3) quality summary (small delta), 4) rollout + SLOs, 5) ops checklist + smoke commands. I'll drop in #eng-ml when ready.

Maya R: Thanks team. Closing action items: Leo perf+quant artifacts + logs (due EOD), Eva one-pager + extended eval (due EOD next day), Sanjay validation script (due +2 days). Re-open if blockers. :thumbsup:

Leo H: Uploaded artifacts: /tmp/orchid/perf_fp16.json, /tmp/orchid/orchid_int8_perf.json, /tmp/orchid/quant_logs.tar.gz

ops-bot: job dj-8812 completed successfully at 2026-03-20T02:52:00Z
